title: Anem a la Cercavila!
author: Laia Argüelles Puigibet Dibuixos: Iraida Llucià Veu: Guillem Solé
school: Escola Marta Mata El Vendrell (Baix Penedès)

areas.en: Physical education, Social sciences, Languages, Miscellaneous

description.en:
Project of activities about the parade of groups El Vendrell. Adressed to kindergarten students. The project has various activities such as puzzles, associations, puzzles and activities relate images with your name. The project is divided into three parts:
  • P3
  • P4
  • P5
This activity is aimed at understanding the popular culture of El Vendrell. It is aimed at students in kindergarten (P-3, P-4, P-5), the activities are sequenced by level. They work for all areas of global education. This "jclic" activities are very diverse.

Realitzarem diverses activitats com trencaclosques, associacions, sopa de lletres i activitats de relacionar imatges amb el seu nom. El projecte està dividit en tres parts:
